exposure: HDP diagnosis (pre-eclampsia vs. other HDP diagnoses)
cohort: 3601 patients with pregnancies complicated with HDP, with 34 cases readmitted for HDP signs/symptoms and 50 controls not readmitted
finding: Readmission for hypertensive disease of pregnancy within 30 days postpartum was rare, but increasing parity and presence of severe disease features were associated with increased risk.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with readmission.
